watcher_classification.unchanged_semantics: All rooted source bytes or declaration names may change, but an explicit old-to-new Lean witness proves the proposition/type relation under both pinned source environments, regeneration is deterministic, and target checks pass. Never infer this from names or syntax alone.
watcher_classification.meaning_change: An old-to-new witness proves non-identity or the source owner changes binders, hypotheses, conclusion, answer-slot type, or required dependency meaning. Invalidate the old correspondence and open a new candidate relation; do not silently retarget reports.
watcher_classification.environment_only_invalidation: Source declaration and copied dependency bytes remain rooted and the old-to-new semantic witness passes, but elaboration or generation fails only after a Lean, Mathlib, generator, Comparator, or target-environment change. Preserve the relation and mark the affected witness unavailable at that environment.
watcher_classification.unprovable_state: Required commits or blobs are unreachable, environments cannot be reconstructed, dependencies or assumptions are missing, regeneration is nondeterministic, or no old-to-new witness can decide the relation. Preserve ambiguity; emit no equivalence claim.
